description: This file contains an extension to the CanvasWindowController class, implementing window creation, presentation, repositioning, and frame persistence logic specifically for macOS using AppKit. It manages both window and panel types, handling their configuration, positioning, and state saving.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSWindow or NSPanel based on the given presentation type and content view.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Presents the panel anchored to a specific position, bringing it to the front and activating the app.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Repositions the panel based on an anchor point, stored frame, and agent overrides, ensuring it remains visible within the screen bounds.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates default top-right positioning for a panel on a given screen.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of the panel window, constrained to visible screen bounds.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines the screen for a given anchor rectangle.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Returns the screen currently containing the mouse cursor.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a given frame is significantly visible within a screen.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Constrains a frame within the bounds of a visible screen area, adjusting size and position as needed.
